no_api_findings.finding: The documented standard library has no HTTP/1.1 message parser. TcpStream transports bytes and BufRead splits input into lines or byte-delimited chunks without interpreting request lines, status lines, headers, or HTTP framing. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid wire controls.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library; external crates and native system libraries are separate.
